# awsappstream_stack_theme (Data Source)

Reads a custom branding theme for an AppStream stack. This data source can be used to reference an existing AppStream stack theme that is managed outside of Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awsappstream_stack_theme" "example" {
  stack_name = "example-stack"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stack_name` (String) The name of the AppStream stack whose theme is read.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The timestamp when the stack theme was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `footer_links` (Attributes Set) Links displayed in the footer of the streaming application catalog page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--footer_links))
- `id` (String) A synthetic identifier for the stack theme, equal to the stack name.
- `state` (String) The current state of the AppStream stack theme.
- `theme_favicon_url` (String) The URL of the icon displayed in the browser tab during streaming sessions.
- `theme_organization_logo_url` (String) The URL of the logo displayed in the catalog page header.
- `theme_styling` (String) The color theme applied to links, text, buttons, and accents in the catalog page.
- `title_text` (String) The title displayed at the top of the browser tab during streaming sessions.

<a id="nestedatt--footer_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `footer_links`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) The name displayed for the footer link.
- `footer_link_url` (String) The URL that the footer link points to.
